valid: save one validated answer and its evidence/question/request/model bindings
restart controller; make fetch/model clients raise if invoked; replay saved answer without invoking either
preserve answer/citations/source-version/retrievedUTC; display historical snapshot and current age
re-answer is explicit new inference, not a replay
negative: tampered body/text/receipt/answer -> explicit error, not successful replay
failed acquisition -> no reusable partial evidence
failed inference may retain valid evidence but no successful answer receipt
age: Current age may change; saved answer content may not silently change. No required exact display wording.
